## Updates

- Activity diffs prepare ahead of time so they open faster.
- Missing repository folders now offer direct actions to locate the folder or stop tracking while preserving collected history.

## Fixes

- Dismissed slash menus stay closed while you continue writing.
- Previous entries keep your reading position during background refreshes.
- The docked Details close button has a consistent circular hover state.

## Supported machines and installation

Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit Intel or AMD (x64).

Download and run `gitorian-0.1.13-windows-x64-setup.exe` from **Assets** below to install Gitorian. Existing installations can download this update in the background and restart when ready.

See the [installation details](https://github.com/XII-A/gitorian#downloads) for unsigned installer warnings and checksums.
